Flow.description: Lead routing entry point (Flow A). Runs when a Lead or Contact is added to a Campaign, e.g. by the HubSpot sync. Leads: new Leads not yet owned by a sales rep are routed by the Lead Routing Engine; Leads not converted within 21 days of their last routing are re-routed when they engage with a different Primary Module. Demo Request, Active Enquiry and In Platform Demo Request set the Lead Status to Ready to Convert. Contacts: a hand-raiser creates a Request for Information Opportunity (unless the Contact already has an open one), owned by the Account Team AM. Owners are notified with the Lead Routing Alert. Skipped when the On/Off Switch Run Flows is unchecked.

formulas.description: Hand-raiser on a Lead not already Ready to Convert, Qualified or Unqualified.
